findings.finding: The inflight models-catalog IIFE's getPort() rejection could propagate as an unhandled 500 instead of degrading to the existing stale/unavailable response shape.
findings.suggestion: Fixed: wrapped the getPort() call in its own try/catch.

findings.finding: The ADR-309 Codex-runtime JSONL-liveness special-case needed a Codextender exclusion; the condition risked duplication across call sites (ws-upgrade-handler.ts).
findings.suggestion: Fixed: extracted isCodexNonCodextenderTask() into runtime-chokepoint.ts and reused it from ws-upgrade-handler.ts.

findings.finding: codexIntegrationMode was read from an independent useSettings() call instead of being passed down from the parent form state, risking a stale/inconsistent read.
findings.suggestion: Fixed: threaded codexIntegrationMode through as a prop from NewIterateModal.tsx's form state.

findings.finding: The new sk-codextender-local placeholder token needed a documented allowlist entry.
findings.suggestion: Fixed: added a third allowlist entry following the file's existing two-entry precedent style, with rationale.

findings.finding: Now-unused useSettings import/call left over after the prop-threading fix.
Codex-runtime error message builders (codextender_proxy_unreachable, codex_cli_not_found) were duplicated risk between runtime-chokepoint.ts and fork.ts, which cannot call the chokepoint directly.
findings.suggestion: Fixed: extracted the three error-builder functions into a new sibling runtime-chokepoint-errors.ts, imported by both call sites.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Reading parent.runtime and parent.codexIntegrationMode directly from the live SdkSessionsStore across multiple await points is safe. — A concurrent store.patch() on the same task (e.g. the user relaunching the parent in another tab) can mutate those fields mid-request, desyncing the preflight check from the command-building branch — a TOCTOU race.
findings.suggestion: Fixed: snapshotted both fields into local consts (parentRuntime, parentCodexIntegrationMode) immediately after store.get(), before any await; used only the locals thereafter. Regression test added in fork.codextender.test.ts.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: injectEnvPrefix's fallback to prepending the env-var block when the cd-prefix doesn't match cwd is a safe defensive default. — It silently produces a command with two cd-prefixes / an ambiguous working directory (e.g. a custom action built from project.path instead of task.cwd) instead of failing loudly, which can launch in the wrong directory undetected.
findings.suggestion: Fixed: added CodextenderCwdMismatchError, thrown instead of silently falling through; runtime-chokepoint.ts catches it and returns a codextender_cwd_mismatch 500. Regression tests added in launcher-codextender.test.ts and runtime-chokepoint.codextender.test.ts.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The qCmd-style escaping helper's quoting model matches cmd.exe's own tokenizer for all inputs. — It does not exactly match cmd.exe's tokenizer for all inputs, though no current caller passes attacker-controlled input through that path, so it is not currently exploitable.
findings.suggestion: Left unfixed by decision — 'don't validate scenarios that can't happen'. This recorded finding stands as the warning for any future extension of this code.
